interpretation.repetition: 21 supported queries (GUM 10, GSD 11), each initially and after fresh Python reopen; one GUM lemma request rejected per process
interpretation.canonical_text: Each revision is exactly one upstream # text comment value. No token-joining, sentence separator insertion, normalization, or claim of original publisher continuous fulltext.
interpretation.token_unit: UD integer-ID syntactic words with exact surface substrings; not MWT surface-token count. Empty nodes remain in raw rows, never indexed as surface words.
interpretation.mwt: All 411 observed GUM ranges are concatenative and map exactly. Nonconcatenative or ambiguous cases reject the entire sentence with an import-ledger reason; this is not universal UD MWT support.
interpretation.attributes: Raw missing underscore values retained for provenance and roundtrip, but an attribute is unavailable for the whole selected scope if any word lacks it. GUM lemma unavailable; GSD lemma available.
interpretation.documents: GUM uses 30 upstream newdoc IDs across sentence revisions. GSD source_document_boundaries=unavailable; matched_documents counts imported_sentence_record units only, never original publication documents.
interpretation.oracle: Independent raw CoNLL-U parser and regex FORM capture-group coordinates; exhaustive finite pattern enumeration, full span list, exact three counts, first 50 KWIC and second-page spans. Also a hand-labelled synthetic fixture tests known answers.
interpretation.reopen: Fresh Python subprocess reopens existing CWB data/registry and mmap coordinate files, reruns complete attribute decoding and all queries; no rebuild and no OS page-cache eviction.
interpretation.timings: Incidental sequential functional timings only. Shared 4 CPU / 8 GiB container, no concurrency or capacity acceptance inference.
interpretation.query_boundary: Positive sentence-scoped form/available lemma/upos equality, phrase, bounded gap, multiple gaps and OR; paragraph, regex, filters, unsafe literal quoting and unavailable attributes remain unsupported. No production API or source publication.
